dslRule:
<!id: list-contains-string-type-mismatch>
<!description: Removes a redundant or incorrect 'List.contains(String)' check when the list's generic type is not String. This often occurs when a list of objects (e.g., IFileStore) is incorrectly checked for the presence of an object's name (a String), leading to a condition that is always false (or always true when negated) due to type mismatch in equals() comparison.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$cond1 && ! $list.contains($arg) :: instanceof($list, "java.util.List") && instanceof($arg, "java.lang.String") && genericTypeIs($list, 0, "org.eclipse.core.filesystem.IFileStore")
=>
$cond1
;;
